timing: Both referrer and friend receive the $25 Amazon Gift Card within 5 business days of the new account being opened.
who_pays: Riverbank Federal Credit Union pays the bonus — it's a $25 Amazon gift card, not cash. Both you (the referrer) and your friend each get one once their new account is opened.
who_qualifies: You must be a Riverbank FCU member for at least 30 days. Your friend must be a new Riverbank FCU member who lives, works, worships, or attends school in Hartford County, CT — or is your immediate family member.
work_available: The Friends and Family Program is live on Riverbank FCU's official site with no published end date or referral cap, so it works right now. Like all referral offers, it can change — check the program page before you pitch it.
what_gets_accepted: Your friend must actually open a new Riverbank FCU account and include your name when applying (online or in-person). If they don't open the account, or forget to name you, nobody gets paid — just mentioning the credit union isn't enough.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees or deposits are required of you as the referrer. The unpaid work is convincing someone to switch credit unions and following up to make sure they complete the account opening — and if they drop out, that time pays nothing.
when_cash_arrives: Within 5 business days after your friend's new account is opened, you both receive a $25 Amazon gift card. It's a gift card, not cash to your bank account.
